outputs.name: Tphl
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) 0.45 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 80p 130p) 0.45 1 "rising" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: Tplh
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) 0.45 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 130p 180p) 0.45 1 "falling" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: Delay
outputs.expression: ((cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) 0.45 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 80p 130p) 0.45 1 "rising" nil nil nil)) + (cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) 0.45 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/IN") 130p 180p) 0.45 1 "falling" nil nil nil))) / 2

outputs.name: Rise
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) 0.81 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) 0.09 1 "rising" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: Fall
outputs.expression: cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) 0.09 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) 0.81 1 "falling" nil nil nil)

outputs.name: RiseFallSkew
outputs.expression: abs((cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) 0.81 1 "rising" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 130p 180p) 0.09 1 "rising" nil nil nil)) - (cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) 0.09 1 "falling" nil nil nil) - cross(clip(VT("/OUT") 80p 130p) 0.81 1 "falling" nil nil nil)))

outputs.name: SupplyEnergyCycle
outputs.expression: -0.9 * integ(IT("/VDD0/PLUS") cross(VT("/IN") 0.45 2 "rising" nil nil nil) cross(VT("/IN") 0.45 3 "rising" nil nil nil))
